spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: suboccipital muscles (rectus capitis post. major/minor, obliquus capitis sup./inf.); minimal/no reliable dermatome
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: none reliably mapped (C1 usually has no cutaneous dermatome)

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: neck flexion (SCM accessory contribution, deep neck flexors)
neck lateral flexion; diaphragm (minor, via phrenic C3-C5)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: lower posterior neck / upper shoulder region

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: shoulder elevation (trapezius accessory contribution); diaphragm (major, phrenic C3-C5: 'C3,4,5 keep the diaphragm alive')
shoulder abduction (deltoid, axillary n.); elbow flexion (biceps, musculocutaneous n.)
elbow flexion + wrist extension (biceps, ECRL/ECRB, radial n.)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: lateral forearm, thumb and index finger

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: elbow extension + wrist flexion (triceps, radial n.; FCR, median n.)
finger flexion (FDP/FDS, median+ulnar n.)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: ring and little finger, medial forearm

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: finger abduction/adduction (intrinsic hand muscles, ulnar n.)
intercostal muscles (respiration), abdominal wall muscles (T7-T12: rectus abdominis, obliques, transversus abdominis)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: T4 = nipple line; T10 = umbilicus; sequential thoracoabdominal bands

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: hip flexion (iliopsoas, minor contribution)
hip flexion (iliopsoas, femoral n.)
knee extension (quadriceps, femoral n.)
ankle dorsiflexion (tibialis anterior, deep fibular n.); knee extension
great toe extension (EHL, deep fibular n.); hip abduction (gluteus medius, superior gluteal n.)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: lateral leg, dorsum of foot, great toe

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: ankle plantarflexion (gastrocnemius/soleus, tibial n.); ankle eversion (peroneus longus/brevis)
spinal_nerves.dermatome_region: lateral foot, little toe, posterior calf

spinal_nerves.myotome_muscles: knee flexion (hamstrings, sciatic n.); toe flexors
intrinsic foot muscles; bladder/bowel (parasympathetic)
pelvic floor (levator ani, external anal/urethral sphincter)
no significant myotome

cranial_nerves.name: Oculomotor
cranial_nerves.function: motor to superior/inferior/medial rectus, inferior oblique, levator palpebrae superioris; parasympathetic to sphincter pupillae/ciliary muscle

cranial_nerves.name: Trigeminal (V1 ophthalmic, V2 maxillary, V3 mandibular)
cranial_nerves.function: facial/oral sensation; V3 also motor to muscles of mastication (masseter, temporalis, pterygoids, mylohyoid, anterior belly digastric, tensor tympani, tensor veli palatini)
cranial_nerves.foramen: V1: superior orbital fissure; V2: foramen rotundum; V3: foramen ovale

cranial_nerves.name: Facial
cranial_nerves.function: motor to muscles of facial expression, stapedius, posterior belly digastric, stylohyoid; taste anterior 2/3 tongue; parasympathetic to lacrimal/submandibular/sublingual glands
cranial_nerves.foramen: internal acoustic meatus -> facial canal -> stylomastoid foramen

cranial_nerves.name: Glossopharyngeal
cranial_nerves.function: motor to stylopharyngeus; taste posterior 1/3 tongue; sensation from pharynx/middle ear; parasympathetic to parotid gland; carotid body/sinus afferents

cranial_nerves.name: Vagus
cranial_nerves.function: motor to pharyngeal/laryngeal muscles (except stylopharyngeus and tensor veli palatini); parasympathetic to thoracic/abdominal viscera to the splenic flexure

cranial_nerves.name: Hypoglossal
cranial_nerves.function: motor to intrinsic and most extrinsic tongue muscles (all except palatoglossus)

sources: AAOS/standard clinical myotome-dermatome charts (as used in ASIA International Standards for Neurological Classification of Spinal Cord Injury)
Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) — chapters 4 (back), 8 (head & neck) for cranial nerve foramina
